claims.assertion: Mari says the Galactic Federation claims Earth and Reptilian societies must remain isolated for different reasons; it portrays Reptilians as aggressive and says it does not control them.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says Reptilians are more aware of galactic society than Earth’s human population.

claims.assertion: Mari describes Reptilian groups as morally diverse, including positive, protective civilizations; she says some have representatives near Earth and may protect their starseeds.
claims.speaker: Mari Swa
claims.qualifiers: She says positive Reptilians may avoid open contact because humans could fear their appearance.
